zh: 欧洲现代哲学研究中心（CRMEP）根据其组织的活动编成了这第二卷文集；本卷各篇文章源自2020年2月29日在伦敦当代艺术学院（ICA）举行的‘思考艺术’会议，当时正值新冠疫情封锁前夕。

与以往一样，我们的设想是汇集一批研究取向多样的国内外演讲者，呈现他们正在进行的研究的一部分，以此勾勒当前研究的一个截面：这些研究涉及一系列相关学科内部及跨学科的议题，哲学与一般理论问题在其中都至关重要。本书涉及数字人文、诗学、美术、艺术史、性别研究、哲学本身、视觉文化与后殖民研究。在此，哲学取其较宽泛的意义，被设想为一种跨学科媒介：通过它，可以把各项具体研究的一般理论层面联系起来，并激发对这些层面的批判性反思。唯物主义、艺术与劳动、形式的不稳定性、社会生态与灾难预感这四重主题星丛——从当下的以太中摘取——既连接又区隔了各项发言。
en: The contributions to this second volume of essays derived from events organized by the Centre for Research in Modern European Philosophy (CRMEP) have their source in the conference ‘Thinking Art’, held at the Institute for Contemporary Arts (ICA) London on 29 February 2020, immediately prior to the Covid-19 lockdown.

As previously, the idea was to assemble an eclectic range of national and international speakers to present parts of their ongoing research, in order to provide a snapshot of current work on topics in which philosophical and general-theoretical issues are at stake within and across a range of related disciplines. Here this includes digital humanities, poetics, fine art, art history, gender studies, philosophy itself, visual culture and postcolonial studies. In its broader sense, philosophy is conceived here as a transdisciplinary medium through which connections may be made between, and critical reflection provoked about, the general-theoretical aspects of concrete investigations. The fourfold thematic constellation of materialisms, art and labour, instabilities of form, and social ecologies and intimations of catastrophe – plucked from the ether of the present – functioned both to connect and to hold apart the various presentations.

zh: 这一次的统一性构想，在于重提 ICA 过去的一个说法——‘思考艺术’

——并非为了返回那个时代，而是为了衡量当下与它之间的距离；这种距离体现于当前的关注与忧虑之中。当时正值1990年代初，对哲学与艺术关系的追问，在很大程度上仍由观念艺术的批判遗产与政治遗产，以及这些遗产留给学院艺术研究的种种反美学议程所驱动。在英国，所调动的理论资源主要是德国批判理论、法国差异哲学（包括拉康精神分析）与女性主义艺术史。论战的背景是：人们试图超越传统美学，延续1960年代和1970年代批判运动的势头。当时，传统美学正主要以现象学的形式复兴，借助的是1980年代由德国新表现主义引领的所谓‘绘画回归’。
交锋的界线清晰分明。
en: The unifying conceit, on this occasion, lay in repeating a trope from the ICA’s past – ‘Thinking Art’

– not in order to return to that time, but rather to take the measure of the present’s distance from it, registered in current preoccupations and concerns. Back then, at the outset of the 1990s, interrogation of the relationship between philosophy and art was still largely driven by the critical and political legacies of conceptual art, and the various anti-aesthetic agendas they bequeathed to academic study of art. The theoretical resources deployed, in the UK, were largely those of German critical theory, French philosophies of difference (including Lacanian psychoanalysis) and feminist art history. The polemical context was the attempt to maintain the momentum of the critical movements of the 1960s and 1970s beyond a traditional aesthetics which was being revived at that time, mainly in phenomenological forms, on the back of the so-called ‘return to painting’ of the 1980s, spearheaded by German neo-expressionism.
The lines of engagement were clearly drawn.

zh: 然而，在接下来的十年里，这些界线很快变得模糊：后现象学的法国“情动”哲学以一种将哲学激进主义主张与艺术上的保守主义、隐秘的政治浪漫主义相结合的方式，进入了“美学”所腾出的概念空间。
en: In the decade that followed, however, those lines quickly became blurred, as post-phenomenological French philosophies of ‘affect’ moved into the conceptual space vacated by ‘aesthetic’, in a manner that combined claims to philosophical radicalism with an artistic conservatism and covert political romanticism.

zh: 与此同时，新形式的文化管理通过一波波意识形态浪潮，将1980年代的批判倾向收编、学院化，并限制在强加给大学的新文化工业形式之内（其中包括将艺术院校并入大学）；这些浪潮的新自由主义力量仍在不断积聚。
随着曾滋养这些倾向的支持性政治文化衰落，那些致力于在
与

之间进行三角定位的艺术实践，在市场日益占据主导地位所伴随的制度变迁面前退却了；这些变迁不仅涉及博物馆、画廊及其他艺术空间被整合进娱乐产业，也涉及艺术教育机构本身。对文化工业的批判性构想，被‘创意产业’这一肯定性的、治理性的概念所取代。在新的大学艺术院校里，人们认为，要实现被改称为客户的学生所预期的职业抱负，几乎无需艺术理论反思，甚至无需更为直接的艺术史知识。正是在这一点上，右翼对艺术与人文学科‘精英主义’的攻击，为‘市场民主’提供了最有效的政治论据——此时距离左翼民粹主义版本的同一批判开始改变这些学科本身，已经过去了三十年；这一过程被右翼讥为‘拉低水准’（dumbing down）。
en: At the same time, new forms of cultural management appropriated, academicized and contained the critical tendencies of the 1980s within the new cultural-industrial forms imposed on universities (including the incorporation of the art schools), in a series of ideological waves, the neoliberal force of which continues to build.
With the decline of the supportive political cultures from which they had arisen, art practices concerned to triangulate relations between
and

retreated in the face of institutional developments associated with the growing primacy of markets, involving not only the integration of museums, galleries and other kinds of art spaces into the entertainment industries, but the institutions of art education themselves. Critical conceptions of the culture industry were displaced by affirmative, governmental concepts of ‘creative industries’. In the new university art schools, little art-theoretical reflection, or even more straightforward forms of art-historical knowledge, were judged necessary for the projected vocational aspirations of students redesignated as clients. This was the point at which right-wing attacks on the ‘elitism’ of the arts and humanities provided ‘market democracy’ with its most effective political argument – three decades after the left-populist version of that critique had begun to transform those disciplines themselves, in a process derided by the Right as ‘dumbing down’.

zh: 今天，为英语世界艺术界奠定思想基调的哲学辩论，主要涉及所谓的‘新’唯物主义——尤其是‘活力’唯物主义与‘思辨’唯物主义；劳动不断变化且不稳定的性质；社会关系与技术的去物质化效应对形式范畴稳定性的冲击；以及生态危机、后殖民性与人类世。本书的四个部分以各种批判性的方式分别处理这些主题的变体。把各篇文章统一起来的，不是某种特定理论立场，而是一种关切：维持对艺术及其相关话语的思考，这种思考对所有企图把新的生态自然主义与活力论当作停止从社会角度思考艺术的托词的做法保持怀疑。在艺术语境中，回避社会性思考无法不变成一种新美学主义——无论其理论模式为何，也无论其声称的政治意图为何。
en: Today, the philosophical debates that set the intellectual tone of the anglophone artworld largely concern so-called ‘new’ – especially ‘vital’ and ‘speculative’ – materialisms; the changing and precarious character of labour; the dematerializing effects of social relations and technologies on the destabilization of formal categories; and ecological crisis, postcoloniality and the Anthropocene. The four sections of this book take up variants of these themes, respectively, in variously critical ways. What unifies the essays is not any particular theoretical stance, but a concern to maintain a thinking of art and its related discourses that is sceptical of all attempts to use the new eco-naturalisms and vitalisms as an alibi for stopping thinking about art socially. In an art context, the flight from thinking socially cannot avoid becoming a neo-aestheticism – whatever its theoretical modalities and purported political intent.

zh: 三十年前，上一本与本卷同名的文集在导论开篇提出了这样一个问题：‘艺术究竟是否需要哲学，哲学究竟是否需要艺术？如果需要，是以何种方式？’这个问题当时没有得到回答，今天仍然一如既往地开放而充满争议；在艺术与哲学双方，它引发焦虑的可能性也与当时同样大，甚至更大。人们或许会想，这更是继续追问它的理由。
en: The question that opened the Introduction to the previous collection of essays with the same title as this one, thirty years ago – ‘In what way, if any, does art need philosophy, or philosophy art?’ – unanswered then, remains as open and contested today as it ever was; and equally, if not more likely to provoke anxiety, on both sides. All the more reason, one might think, for continuing to ask it.

zh: Klara Kemp-Welch 与 Christian Nyampeta 未能出席会议，但慷慨地允许其作品在此发表。
en: Klara Kemp-Welch and Christian Nyampeta were unable to attend the conference, but have generously made their work available here.
